topic: Linear Algebra: From Geometry to Spaces

sections.title: Geometric Interpretation of Linear Systems
lecture_lines: Systems represent intersections of geometric objects.
Solutions are the specific meeting points.
Linear algebra links geometry and computation.
animations: Draw a 2D plane with lines #FF5733 (Line A) and #33FF57 (Line B).
Highlight the intersection point #FFFF33 where both lines cross.
Animate a vector #33A1FF moving from origin to intersection point.

sections.title: Inverse Matrices: The 'Undo' Button
lecture_lines: They act like undo buttons for space.
Applying A then inverse restores original points.
animations: Show matrix A #FFFFFF and vector x #FF5733 as input using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/button.svg].
Display matrix A_inverse #33FF57 transforming result back to x.
Visualize the restoration process with a 'morphing' effect using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/button.svg].

sections.title: Column Space: Where Can We Go?
lecture_lines: Column space is the reachable territory.
Independent vectors cover the full space.
Dependent vectors collapse space into lower dimensions.
animations: Draw two basis vectors #FF5733 and #33FF57 originating from center, overlaying the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] to indicate orientation.
Fill the span of vectors with a shaded region #33A1FF.
Demonstrate adding a third vector falling within the span, referencing the spatial layout shown on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg].

sections.title: Null Space: What Gets Crushed?
lecture_lines: Null space contains vectors squashed to zero.
It identifies what the transformation destroys.
animations: Show a transformation squashing space onto a line #FF5733 using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shredder.svg] to represent the reduction.
Highlight the origin point #FFFF33 mapped to by the line.
Animate vectors along the null space collapsing to zero.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Inverses exist when space is preserved.
These concepts unify linear systems theory.
animations: Flash the four core concepts #FFFFFF in a grid layout.
Show them converging into a single unified formula #FFFF33.
Fade all elements out, leaving only the central formula.
